description: Plugin-action dispatch returns immediately with {job_id, status: queued}. A single plugin-owned worker performs the operation. Retain the exact job_id and poll service_interface::job_service::get_job until terminal before consuming the result. The former complete response envelope is stored in job.result (status-reader result for reconciliation); failures also retain job.error. Read-only introspection of the local-blue-green router's current state. Plugin-namespace registration backing the service-interface verb service_interface::local_self_deployment_service::swap_status. Returns the router's status() payload (active_color, known colors, color → bridge_port mappings, drain entries with timestamps) plus the plugin's own swap-in-progress state. No side effects. Operator-invocable for diagnostic / pre-restart checks. This plugin-action face is asynchronous. The public service_interface::local_self_deployment_service::swap_status face and the Python business method remain synchronous and retain their original result on the existing service executor path.
embedding_description: Queue a router status snapshot on the plugin worker and return a job handle. Poll job_service.get_job for the original router status and local swap state in job.result.data. The separate public local_self_deployment_service face remains synchronous on its existing service executor.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Immediate receipt: job_id (string), status (queued). The original result described below is available only after job completion. active_color, known colors, color → bridge_port map, drain entries, swap_in_progress flag.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Retain job_id; poll service_interface::job_service::get_job until completed/error/cancelled. Do not infer completion from the receipt. Read the former result from the terminal job. Lead with active_color. Surface drain entries if any (operator may be in a swap window). Surface swap_in_progress=true if mid-cycle. Otherwise terse: just the active_color + registered colors.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Dependent steps must wait for terminal job.result and then consume job.result.data. Handle terminal errors before continuing.

error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: router_unavailable: ~/.ananta/runtime/<name>.router.sock not present or unreachable. router_status_unparseable: router responded but the payload was malformed (platform bug).
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: If router is unavailable, install via plugins/macos_self_deployment_plugin/src/macos_self_deployment_plugin/blue_green_router/install_router.py and retry. Read-only verb: safe to retry.
